newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end slightly down but off lows.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end slightly down but off lows.

text.p: Jakarta share prices ended slightly down but off their lows on Thursday after some window-dressing spurred fresh buying in late trading, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.25 points, or 0.04 percent, to close at 632.50 points after touching a low of 629.23 points.

Gainers matched losers at 39, with 74 counters unchanged. Overall volume was 83.1 million shares and total turnover 199.3 billion rupiah, boosted by the block-trade of Astra International and cross-trade of Bimantara Citra.

The country's largest car maker, Astra International traded on the block board at 5,500 rupiah on a volume of 10 million shares. Brokers said there was speculation one of its majority shareholders had sold his stake in Astra but no confirmation was immediately available.
Conglomerate Bimantara Citra traded on the cross board at a price of 3,175 rupiah on volume of eight million shares.
Brokers said the market was likely to remain slow on Friday but the listing of poultry agriculture and food firm Sierad Produce could give a boost to market sentiment.
"Friday is the last trading day. I think the index will be moving in a tight-range as many brokers are in a holiday mood," a local broker said.
The stock exchange will close from December 30 and resume trading on January 2.

Chicken restaurant franchiser Putra Sejahtera topped the active list with 4.5 million shares traded, rising 125 rupiah to 2,400 rupiah on speculative buying due to year-end window dressing, brokers said.
Property firm Summarecon and Putra Surya Perkasa were among the gainers, also actively traded on year-end window-dressing, they said.
Summarecon rose 25 rupiah to 800 on 3.5 million shares, while Putra Surya rose 150 rupiah to 2,225 on 1.3 million shares.
Bank Negara Indonesia and retailer Matahari were among the losers on profit taking, brokers said.
Bank Negara Indonesia fell 25 rupiah to 1,275 on 3.1 million shares, while Matahari fell 100 rupiah to 2,700 on 811,500 shares.
